scope.purpose: Identify trading fee generation, destination, handling protocol, downstream use, and compare documented claims with on-chain evidence.
rules: On-chain account state and transaction evidence are authoritative where available.
UNKNOWN is preserved when evidence is insufficient.
Network transaction fees are excluded from protocol trading-fee economics.
Creator/recipient identity is not assumed from labels alone.
Fee economics score is separate from verification confidence.

venue_mapping.note: Phase 4 is the discovery source. Pools are deduplicated by venue/program/pool. Unsupported concentrated-liquidity fee models are not guessed.

venues.source: official PumpSwap program docs / current on-chain GlobalConfig
venues.note: GlobalConfig gives the current AMM base fee components. Canonical PumpSwap fees may vary by market-cap schedule; the transaction/program state is treated as authoritative for verification.

fee_components.name: LP_FEE
fee_components.note: LP fee is accounted to the pool by program design; direct per-trade attribution is not inferred from pool balance alone.
fee_components.observation_note: LP fee is retained in pool economics; direct fee attribution is not inferred from a single pool balance delta.
fee_components.evidence_basis: Some fee evidence exists, but coverage or verification is incomplete.

fee_components.name: PROTOCOL_FEE
fee_components.observation_note: PumpSwap trade instruction explicitly included the matched protocol fee destination and the same transaction showed a positive destination balance delta. This verifies routing only; it does not prove recipient ownership or downstream economic purpose.
fee_components.evidence_basis: Technical fee/routing activity observed; economic function remains unverified.

fee_components.observation_note: PumpSwap trade instruction explicitly included the matched creator-vault destination and the same transaction showed a positive destination balance delta. This verifies routing only; it does not prove creator ownership or downstream economic purpose.

claim_vs_reality.rule: CLAIM_ONLY is not CONFLICT; conflict requires positive conflicting on-chain evidence.

flows.ownership_note: Being a configured protocol fee recipient does not prove protocol/creator ownership. A third party may provide liquidity or otherwise control an address; downstream outflow is not attributed without direct ownership evidence.
